title: Geode active-workspace hero v2
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: NEW landscape 16:9 website hero for Aura Genesis Observer Studio. Input image 1 is the authoritative Aura Genesis Geode Atlas seated HBOT concept reference. Input image 2 is the canonical Aura geometry board, used ONLY for a small source-faithful pattern on the experience display. Preserve the exact compact one-person chamber architecture in image 1: an upright adjustable ivory recliner, a full-height transparent front door hinged and swung fully aside on the right, clear low threshold and assisted-entry floor, reachable side-mounted adjustable haptic display facing the seated person, a recognisable lightweight XR headset on its side dock, two neatly parked wearable bands, recessed sensor sockets and a discreet receiver in the genuine side service bay. Equipment is mounted inside the shell beside the seat, never on the door; keep elbow, shoulder and head room. Preserve the smooth lined interior and the reference's manufactured ivory/quartz/lilac/mint mineral-composite shell with restrained champagne seams: this is a shaped enclosure, never a natural rock geode, floating gemstone or crystal cave. Transform the isolated product shot into an inviting believable working design-studio setting with warm indirect daylight, tactile materials and calm dark-plum/deep-jade architecture. The chamber and equipment occupy the RIGHT 58% of the wide frame, three-quarter front view at seated eye height. Keep the LEFT 40% visually quiet, a softly lit dark wall and subtle floor with no equipment or text, for a large headline. Add a modest separate external AI-compute workstation beyond the chamber on the far right or rear, visibly outside the pressure enclosure, with a compact serviceable compute cabinet and a single small monitor showing restrained abstract facet-stack cards and a document/page preview. That general-AI workstation is physically and visually distinct from the chamber's own dedicated controller; do not connect AI controls to the pressure system, do not merge their interfaces, and do not show AI pressure settings or a treatment readout. The chamber's side EXPERIENCE display can show the broad nested horn-torus wireframe from the RIGHT MAIN geometry image of reference 2, seven nested shells sharing a central pinch, no open hole, with a few abstract reflection cards beneath it. No giant holograms and no fantasy interfaces. The open door and clear entry indicate a prepared active workspace/rehearsal before any pressure session; no person receiving treatment and no implied certification. No people, masks, logos, labels, numbers, readable UI text, certification seals or operating instructions. Make the apparatus compact and usable, not a walk-in room. Editorial architectural product photography, realistic materials, plausible clean cable routing, calm warm light, highly legible layout, premium but practical. This image is a speculative design visualisation, not a photograph of installed or approved medical equipment. Preserve the reference setup rather than inventing a different chamber.
